adverse_strong.title: IN RE: EXPEDITIOUS TRIAL OF CASES UNDER SECTION 138 OF N.I. ACT 1881 versus .
adverse_strong.label: OVERRULES
adverse_strong.speaker: court
adverse_strong.sentence: The judgment of this Court in Meters and Instruments (supra) in so far as it conferred power on the Trial Court to discharge an accused is not good law.
adverse_strong.prev: Therefore, Section 258 cannot come into play in respect of the complaints filed under Section 138 of the Act.
adverse_strong.next: Support taken from the words “as far as may be” in Section 143 of the Act is inappropriate.

adverse_strong.title: IN RE: EXPEDITIOUS TRIAL OF CASES UNDER SECTION 138 OF N.I. ACT 1881 versus .
adverse_strong.label: OVERRULES
adverse_strong.cue: do not lay down correct law
adverse_strong.speaker: court
adverse_strong.sentence: 7) Section 258 of the Code is not applicable to complaints under Section 138 of the Act and findings to the contrary in Meters and Instruments (supra) do not lay down correct law.
adverse_strong.prev: This does not affect the power of the Trial Court under Section 322 of the Code to revisit the order of issue of process in case it is brought to the court’s notice that it lacks jurisdiction to try the complaint.
adverse_strong.next: To conclusively deal with this aspect, amendment to the Act empowering the Trial Courts to reconsider/recall summons in respect of complaints under Section 138 shall be considered by the Committee constituted by an order of this Court dated 10.03.2021. 8) All other points, which have been raised by the Amici Curiae in their preliminary report and written submissions and not considered herein, shall be the subject matter of deliberation by the aforementioned Committee.

coverage.note: Indian Kanoon's counts are typed from a screenshot of its yearly list (2026-10-05) and may include orders or duplicates; the share is a rough guide. The collection is the Supreme Court's own site to 4 May 2017 and the open Dattam Labs bucket after that, which holds only part of each year.

limits: Triage is a reading aid made by pattern rules over the sentences that name the case; it is not legal advice and not a verdict.
Only Supreme Court judgments we hold are searched; High Court treatment and judgments we lack are invisible.
Each quoted sentence was checked word for word against the judgment's text; the reading of it is a rule's, so a person must confirm.
The law reporter's case-law table (judgments of 2017 to 2023) is the reporter's annotation, not the court's words; judgments of 2024 on print no such table.
